block.analogaudio.speaker: Live Speaker Block
analogaudio.ponder.speaker_intro.text_1: Live Speakers play back voices from walkie talkies on its same frequency.
analogaudio.ponder.speaker_redstone.head: Live Speakers and Redstone
analogaudio.ponder.speaker_redstone.text: Live Speakers will output a redstone signal when a player is talking.
Display links will display the name of a player when they are talking.
